name: Vaughan decomposition of $S(\alpha)$ and dyadic bounds: Liu-Wang Decomp1543a
description:
The von Mangoldt function $\Lambda(n)$ equals $\log p$ when $n$ is a positive power of a prime $p$, and is zero otherwise. Its exponential sum $S_\Lambda(c,N,\alpha)=\sum_{1\le n\le N,\ cN<n}\Lambda(n)e^{2\pi i\alpha n}$ measures cancellation in the distribution of prime powers. Here $N$ is a natural cutoff and $c,\alpha$ are real parameters. The Möbius function $\mu$ supplies the arithmetic weights in Vaughan's four-part decomposition.

This mission packages the coefficient identity, its exponential-sum assembly, and the dyadic and counting statements appearing in the lab's treatment of the fourth component. It includes a rational approximation condition $|\alpha-a/q|\le q^{-2}$ with $q\ge1$ and $\gcd(a,q)=1$, a truncated reciprocal-distance kernel, second-moment inequalities, and an explicit squarefree count. The individual statements have their own hypotheses; restrictions from the surrounding analytic argument are not silently added. The strict lower cutoff and the finite truncations are part of the formal specification.

The source is Ming-Chit Liu and Tianze Wang, [On the Vinogradov bound in the three primes Goldbach conjecture](https://doi.org/10.4064/aa105-2-3), *Acta Arithmetica* 105, 2002, pp. 133 to 175, especially Section 6, pp. 168 to 174. The kernel estimate is cited there from Wang and Chen 1994, Lemma 2; the lab interprets its distance as distance to the nearest integer. Explicit estimates for these sums support quantitative applications of the circle method. This mission claims no progress on binary Goldbach, which remains open.

These statements come from an AI-run Lean lab. Drafts are audited by a human before submission to the public platform; this draft is prepared for that audit. The mission preserves eleven open declarations and presents the lab's existing assembly as its single goal. No proof is supplied here.

end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For real $x$, define $e(x)=\exp(2\pi i x)$.

import Mathlib

open Real Finset ArithmeticFunction

namespace LL_Decomp1543a
noncomputable def nint (x : ℝ) : ℝ := |x - round x|
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For real $x$, define $\operatorname{nint}(x)=|x-\operatorname{round}(x)|$, the distance to the nearest integer.

import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_LL_Decomp1543a_nint

open Real Finset ArithmeticFunction

namespace LL_Decomp1543a
noncomputable def minK (X θ : ℝ) : ℝ := if nint θ = 0 then X else min X (1 / (2 * nint θ))
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For real $X,\theta$, define $K(X,\theta)=X$ when $\operatorname{nint}(\theta)=0$, and otherwise $K(X,\theta)=\min\{X,1/(2\operatorname{nint}(\theta))\}$.

namespace LL_Decomp1543a
noncomputable def rangeN (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := (Icc 1 N).filter (fun n => c * N < n)
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For real $c$ and natural $N$, define $R(c,N)=\{n\in\mathbb N:1\le n\le N,\ cN<n\}$.

import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_LL_Decomp1543a_e
import Definitions.Def_LL_Decomp1543a_rangeN

open Real Finset ArithmeticFunction

namespace LL_Decomp1543a
noncomputable def Ssum (f : ℕ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (α : ℝ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ n ∈ rangeN c N, (f n : ℂ) * e (α * n)
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For $f:\mathbb N\to\mathbb R$, real $c,\alpha$ and natural $N$, define $S_f(c,N,\alpha)=\sum_{n\in R(c,N)}f(n)e(\alpha n)$.

import Mathlib

open Real Finset ArithmeticFunction

namespace LL_Decomp1543a
noncomputable def lam1 (U : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ := if (n : ℝ) ≤ U then vonMangoldt n else 0
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For real $U$ and natural $n$, define $\Lambda_1(U,n)=\Lambda(n)$ if $n\le U$, and zero otherwise, where $\Lambda$ is the von Mangoldt function.

items.definition:
import Mathlib

open Real Finset ArithmeticFunction

namespace LL_Decomp1543a
noncomputable def lam2 (V : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ t ∈ n.divisors.filter (fun t : ℕ => (t : ℝ) ≤ V), (moebius t : ℝ) * Real.log ((n / t : ℕ) : ℝ)
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For real $V$ and natural $n$, define $\Lambda_2(V,n)=\sum_{t\mid n,\ t\le V}\mu(t)\log(n/t)$, using natural-number division in the logarithm; $\mu$ is the Möbius function and the divisor sum is empty at $n=0$.

items.definition:
import Mathlib

open Real Finset ArithmeticFunction

namespace LL_Decomp1543a
noncomputable def lam3 (U V : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  -∑ r ∈ n.divisors, ∑ t ∈ n.divisors,
    if (r : ℝ) ≤ U ∧ (t : ℝ) ≤ V ∧ r * t ∣ n then vonMangoldt r * (moebius t : ℝ) else 0
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For real $U,V$ and natural $n$, define $\Lambda_3(U,V,n)=-\sum_{r\mid n}\sum_{t\mid n,\ r\le U,\ t\le V,\ rt\mid n}\Lambda(r)\mu(t)$, with empty divisor sums at $n=0$.

items.definition:
import Mathlib

open Real Finset ArithmeticFunction

namespace LL_Decomp1543a
noncomputable def am (U : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ r ∈ m.divisors.filter (fun r : ℕ => U < (r : ℝ)), vonMangoldt r
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For real $U$ and natural $m$, define $a_m(U)=\sum_{r\mid m,\ U<r}\Lambda(r)$, with an empty divisor sum at $m=0$.

items.definition:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_LL_Decomp1543a_am

open Real Finset ArithmeticFunction

namespace LL_Decomp1543a
noncomputable def lam4 (U V : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ t ∈ n.divisors.filter (fun t : ℕ => V < (t : ℝ)), (moebius t : ℝ) * am U (n / t)
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For real $U,V$ and natural $n$, define $\Lambda_4(U,V,n)=\sum_{t\mid n,\ V<t}\mu(t)a_{n/t}(U)$, using natural-number division and an empty divisor sum at $n=0$.

import Mathlib

open Real Finset ArithmeticFunction

namespace LL_Decomp1543a
def Dioph (α : ℝ) (a : ℤ) (q : ℕ) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ q ∧ Int.gcd a q = 1 ∧ |α - a / q| ≤ 1 / (q : ℝ) ^ 2
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For real $\alpha$, integer $a$ and natural $q$, define $\operatorname{Dioph}(\alpha,a,q)$ to mean $q\ge1$, $\gcd(a,q)=1$ and $|\alpha-a/q|\le q^{-2}$.

end LL_Decomp1543a

namespace LL_Decomp1543a
noncomputable def Jn (N : ℕ) (U V : ℝ) : ℕ := ⌊Real.log (N / (U * V)) / Real.log 2⌋₊ + 1

items.definition_title: Wang and Chen short-interval kernel estimate
items.definition:
import Mathlib
import Definitions.Def_LL_Decomp1543a_nint
import Definitions.Def_LL_Decomp1543a_minK
import Definitions.Def_LL_Decomp1543a_Dioph

open Real Finset ArithmeticFunction

namespace LL_Decomp1543a
def WCLemma2 : Prop :=
  ∀ (α : ℝ) (a : ℤ) (q : ℕ), Dioph α a q → ∀ X : ℝ, 0 < X → ∀ (Y : ℕ) (Z : ℤ), 1 ≤ Y →
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc Z (Z + Y), minK X (α * n) ≤ (((Y / q : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * (5 * X + q * Real.log q)
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: Define $\mathrm{WCLemma2}$ to assert that, for all $\operatorname{Dioph}(\alpha,a,q)$, real $X>0$, natural $Y\ge1$ and integer $Z$, $\sum_{Z<n\le Z+Y}K(X,\alpha n)\le(\lfloor Y/q\rfloor+1)(5X+q\log q)$, where $n$ ranges over integers and $Y/q$ is natural-number division.

items.formal_statement:
namespace LL_Decomp1543a
theorem wc_lemma2 : WCLemma2 := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: The proposition $\mathrm{WCLemma2}$ holds: for every $\operatorname{Dioph}(\alpha,a,q)$, real $X>0$, natural $Y\ge1$ and integer $Z$, $\sum_{Z<n\le Z+Y}K(X,\alpha n)\le(\lfloor Y/q\rfloor+1)(5X+q\log q)$. The kernel uses distance to the nearest integer, as specified by the lab.

namespace LL_Decomp1543a
theorem vaughan_coeff (U V : ℝ) (hV : 1 ≤ V) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (vonMangoldt n : ℝ) = lam1 U n + lam2 V n + lam3 U V n + lam4 U V n := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For every real $U,V$ with $V\ge1$ and natural $n\ge1$, $\Lambda(n)=\Lambda_1(U,n)+\Lambda_2(V,n)+\Lambda_3(U,V,n)+\Lambda_4(U,V,n)$. No lower bound on $U$ is assumed.

items.theorem_title: Cauchy bound for a Möbius-weighted sum
items.formal_statement:
namespace LL_Decomp1543a
theorem block_cauchy (T : Finset ℕ) (z : ℕ → ℂ) :
    ‖∑ t ∈ T, (moebius t : ℂ) * z t‖ ≤
      √(∑ t ∈ T, |(moebius t : ℝ)|) * √(∑ t ∈ T, ‖z t‖ ^ 2) := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For every finite $T\subset\mathbb N$ and function $z:\mathbb N\to\mathbb C$, $\left|\sum_{t\in T}\mu(t)z(t)\right|\le\sqrt{\sum_{t\in T}|\mu(t)|}\sqrt{\sum_{t\in T}|z(t)|^2}$.

items.theorem_title: Geometric sum on a dyadic integer interval
items.formal_statement:
namespace LL_Decomp1543a
theorem geom_dyadic (θ M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (A B : ℤ) (hA : ⌊M⌋ ≤ A) (hB : B ≤ ⌊2 * M⌋) :
    ‖∑ t ∈ Ioc A B, e (θ * t)‖ ≤ minK (M + 1 / 2) θ := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For all real $\theta$, $M\ge0$ and integers $A,B$ with $\lfloor M\rfloor\le A$ and $B\le\lfloor2M\rfloor$, $\left|\sum_{A<t\le B}e(\theta t)\right|\le K(M+1/2,\theta)$. The statement imposes no further restriction on $M$ or on the order of $A,B$.

items.theorem_title: Second-moment bound conditional on geometric sums
items.formal_statement:
namespace LL_Decomp1543a
theorem square_expand (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (U M α : ℝ) (hU : 0 ≤ U) (hM : 1 ≤ M)
    (hgeom : ∀ θ : ℝ, ∀ A B : ℤ, ⌊M⌋ ≤ A → B ≤ ⌊2 * M⌋ →
      ‖∑ t ∈ Ioc A B, e (θ * t)‖ ≤ minK (M + 1 / 2) θ) :
    ∑ t ∈ tBlock N M, ‖inner c N U α t‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ m ∈ lRange N U (N / M), am U m ^ 2 *
        ∑ l ∈ lRange N U (N / M), minK (M + 1 / 2) (α * ((m : ℝ) - l)) := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For real $c,\alpha$, natural $N$, $U\ge0$ and $M\ge1$, assume $\left|\sum_{A<t\le B}e(\theta t)\right|\le K(M+1/2,\theta)$ for every real $\theta$ and integers $A,B$ with $\lfloor M\rfloor\le A$ and $B\le\lfloor2M\rfloor$. Conditional on that hypothesis, $\sum_{t\in T(N,M)}|I(c,N,U,\alpha,t)|^2\le\sum_{m\in L(N,U,N/M)}a_m(U)^2\sum_{l\in L(N,U,N/M)}K(M+1/2,\alpha(m-l))$.

items.theorem_title: Kernel sum conditional on the Wang and Chen input
items.formal_statement:
namespace LL_Decomp1543a
theorem inner_l_sum (hwc : WCLemma2) (α : ℝ) (a : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hD : Dioph α a q) (N : ℕ)
    (U Y X : ℝ) (hU : 0 ≤ U) (hX : 0 < X) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ l ∈ lRange N U Y, minK X (α * ((m : ℝ) - l)) ≤
      ((((⌊Y⌋₊ - ⌊U⌋₊) / q : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * (5 * X + q * Real.log q) := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: Assume $\mathrm{WCLemma2}$ and $\operatorname{Dioph}(\alpha,a,q)$. For every natural $N,m$, real $U\ge0$, real $Y$ and real $X>0$, $\sum_{l\in L(N,U,Y)}K(X,\alpha(m-l))\le\left(\left\lfloor\frac{\max(\lfloor Y\rfloor_+-\lfloor U\rfloor_+,0)}q\right\rfloor+1\right)(5X+q\log q)$, where the subtraction and division in the bracket are natural-number operations.

items.theorem_title: Dyadic decomposition of the fourth Vaughan sum
items.formal_statement:
namespace LL_Decomp1543a
theorem S4_dyadic (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (U V α : ℝ) (hU : 0 < U) (hV : 0 < V) :
    Ssum (lam4 U V) c N α = ∑ j ∈ range (Jn N U V), block c N U (2 ^ j * V) α := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For every real $c,\alpha$, natural $N$ and positive real $U,V$, $S_{\Lambda_4(U,V,\cdot)}(c,N,\alpha)=\sum_{0\le j<J(N,U,V)}B(c,N,U,2^jV,\alpha)$. No additional hypothesis $UV\le N$ is present.

namespace LL_Decomp1543a
theorem dyadic_sqrt_sum (N : ℕ) (U V : ℝ) (hU : 0 < U) (hV : 0 < V) (J : ℕ) (hJ : 1 ≤ J)
    (hJV : 2 ^ (J - 1) * V ≤ N / U) :
    ∑ j ∈ range J, √(2 ^ j * V) ≤ (2 + √2) * √(N / U) := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For natural $N$, positive real $U,V$ and natural $J\ge1$ satisfying $2^{J-1}V\le N/U$, $\sum_{0\le j<J}\sqrt{2^jV}\le(2+\sqrt2)\sqrt{N/U}$.

items.formal_statement:
namespace LL_Decomp1543a
theorem J_props (N : ℕ) (U V : ℝ) (hU : 0 < U) (hV : 0 < V) (hUV : U * V ≤ N) :
    2 ^ (Jn N U V - 1) * V ≤ N / U ∧
      (Jn N U V : ℝ) ≤ 1 + Real.log (N / (U * V)) / Real.log 2 := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For natural $N$ and positive real $U,V$ satisfying $UV\le N$, let $J=J(N,U,V)$. Then $2^{J-1}V\le N/U$ and $J\le1+\log(N/(UV))/\log2$, with natural-number subtraction in $J-1$.

items.formal_statement:
namespace LL_Decomp1543a
theorem S_split (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (U V α : ℝ) (hV : 1 ≤ V) :
    Ssum (fun n => (vonMangoldt n : ℝ)) c N α =
      Ssum (lam1 U) c N α + Ssum (lam2 V) c N α + Ssum (lam3 U V) c N α +
        Ssum (lam4 U V) c N α := by sorry
end LL_Decomp1543a
items.natural_language_statement: For every real $c,U,V,\alpha$ and natural $N$ with $V\ge1$, $S_\Lambda(c,N,\alpha)=S_{\Lambda_1(U,\cdot)}(c,N,\alpha)+S_{\Lambda_2(V,\cdot)}(c,N,\alpha)+S_{\Lambda_3(U,V,\cdot)}(c,N,\alpha)+S_{\Lambda_4(U,V,\cdot)}(c,N,\alpha)$. All sums use the strict lower cutoff $cN<n$ and $1\le n\le N$; this is the lab assembly conditional on the coefficient identity.
